title: Cleaning and Damage Fees — Dispute and Refund Terms Sheet
content:
The dispute and refund terms of Cleaning and Damage Fees, set per fee level by the payments and disputes team. The values are the same at all six levels.

| Fee level | Dispute window | Disputes per assessment | Reviewer may move the level | Direction a level may move | Partial refund basis | Refunds returned to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | 30 calendar days after the charge date | 1 | Yes | down only | fee difference | original payment method |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | 30 calendar days after the charge date | 1 | Yes | down only | fee difference | original payment method |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | 30 calendar days after the charge date | 1 | Yes | down only | fee difference | original payment method |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | 30 calendar days after the charge date | 1 | Yes | down only | fee difference | original payment method |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | 30 calendar days after the charge date | 1 | Yes | down only | fee difference | original payment method |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | 30 calendar days after the charge date | 1 | Yes | down only | fee difference | original payment method |

## Terms

1. **Dispute window.** The rider may dispute the fee within 30 calendar days after the charge date.
2. **Disputes per assessment.** At most 1 dispute per assessment.
3. **Evidence standard.** A disputed fee is upheld when the evidence on file met the level's photo and receipt requirements at approval; otherwise it is reversed.
4. **Weight of the rider's statement.** A rider's account alone never reverses a fee backed by evidence that meets the standard; it is not sufficient on its own.
5. **Reclassification.** A reviewer may move a report to a different level when the evidence shows one, and the direction a level may move at review or dispute is down only.
6. **Partial refund basis.** When a charged fee is reclassified to a lower level, the rider is refunded the difference between the two fees.
7. **Refund destination.** Refunds return to the original payment method.

## Notes

- "Down only" means a level can move to a lower-ranked level and never to a higher one, whether at review or at dispute.
- The evidence standard looks at what was on file at approval, not at evidence sent in after the fee was charged.
